articles.description: The role of global science, academia, research and innovation is enshrined in the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction where it is recognized for the catalytic, boundary-pushing and transformative potential it holds for addressing the dynamic drivers of disaster risk.

articles.description: The UN Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR), in collaboration with the Chief Resilience Officer (CCRO) network, has published a thought leadership article in Harvard Business Review.

articles.title: United Nations Senior Leaders call for stronger joint action to reduce disaster risk and protect development gains
articles.description: Thirty-six UN entities convened to reinforce disaster risk reduction as central to sustainable development, adopting new targets and priority actions to guide coordinated country-level support through 2030.

articles.title: Early Warning Systems for mobile populations: Operational guidance
